name: ontos
description: Ontos: an open-source Ontology service and CLI for PostgreSQL and OSDK.

scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script -p . && bun check --no-script -p packages/service && bun check --no-script -p packages/cli
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:mcp
scripts.test:changed: vitest run --changed origin/main --project unit --project mcp --project sql --testTimeout=30000 --hookTimeout=30000 --exclude 'tools/ops/restore-ontology-*.sql.test.ts'
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:dropped && bun run knip && bun run test:unit
scripts.check:pkg: publint packages/service && publint packages/cli && attw --pack --profile esm-only packages/service && attw --pack --profile esm-only packages/cli
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/service build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build
scripts.release: changeset version && bun install --lockfile-only && bun fmt
